policy.privacy_intro: This policy explains how Ay Khidma uses your information when you register and request home services.
policy.data_body: We store your name and the sign-in methods you add, such as a username, email or phone number. Service information includes your selected location, requests, offers, conversations, attachments and verification documents you upload.
policy.purpose_body: We use this information to operate your account, connect customers and providers, manage requests and offers, send service notifications and handle complaints and disputes.
policy.location_body: Device location is optional. You can select an area, city and neighborhood manually. When you use the map or location button, the point’s coordinates are sent to the map service to help identify an address. Check the city and neighborhood before saving because address detection may be approximate.
policy.sharing_body: Public provider profiles are visible to people looking for services. Request participants exchange the information needed to perform the work. Ay Khidma and its data are hosted on the platform's own server; maps come from OpenFreeMap using OpenStreetMap data. Voice and video calls pass through the platform's server and are never recorded. Administrators may review conversation records when resolving disputes under the terms and access permissions.
policy.records_body: Requests, offers, conversations and attachments are retained to support service tracking and dispute resolution. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes and are not displayed in profiles.
policy.controls_body: You can correct account details and location in your profile and clear saved coordinates. Share only information needed for the service. Keep passwords and unnecessary sensitive information out of conversations and attachments.
policy.terms_unavailable: The terms could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
policy.default_terms_html:
Terms and conditions — Ay Khidma

1. Acceptance of use
By registering with Ay Khidma, you agree to these terms and confirm that you have reached the age of majority under the laws applicable in your country.

2. Accurate information
You undertake that all information you provide (name, phone number, email, location and documents) is correct. Misleading information may lead to immediate suspension of your account.

3. Service and payment
The platform connects customers with service providers. You agree on the work and price directly. The platform acts as an arbitrator in disputes according to conversation records and the agreement.

4. Conversation review for quality and reliability
You acknowledge and consent that platform administrators may review text and voice conversations and location-sharing records between you and the other party, exclusively in the following cases:

  • When either party opens a dispute or complaint
  • To verify the agreement was carried out and protect rights
  • To check for content that violates the law or public decency
  • To verify the reliability of new service providers before approving them

Every review is recorded in an internal audit log with its time and the staff member’s identity. It is not used for marketing or for purposes outside these cases.

5. Personal data protection
Your information will not be shared with a third party without your permission except by court order. You may request deletion of your account and all your data at any time.

6. Acceptable conduct
The following are strictly prohibited: fraud, insults, offensive content, requesting or paying amounts outside the platform, and impersonation. A violation leads to permanent suspension.

7. Changes to the terms
The platform may update this document. After any material change, you will be asked to accept the terms again when you next sign in.

8. Applicable law
These terms are subject to the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the member countries according to your location.

meta.description: Ay Khidma — Faster service, easier life. Request plumbing, electrical work and yard cleaning across Saudi Arabia and compare provider offers.

help.title: User guide
help.subtitle: Clear steps to request or provide a service with Ay Khidma, from signing up to completing the work.
help.choose_role: Choose what you want to do
help.client_intro: Start with the service you need, compare offers and agree with the right provider.
help.provider_intro: Tell customers about your profession, services and work area, then send clear offers for suitable requests.

browse.title: Sign up with your phone and a simple password
browse.body: Sign up with your phone number and a simple password of at least 4 digits, so no one else signs in as you; the name is optional, and your area is detected automatically and can be changed. On the home page pick a profession from the list to see how many providers serve your area and how many are available now.

details.title: Pick the profession, record what you need
details.body: Tap "Order now" and pick the profession needed, the only required field. The sub-service and title are optional, and you can record what you need by voice and attach a photo or video. Tap "Post": your location is known from sign-up, and price and time are agreed in the chat.

location.title: Check the service location
location.body: Your saved account address and location are filled in automatically. Check them and edit them for this request if needed. To update your account for future requests, select “Save this location as my default for future requests”; the change is saved after the request is sent successfully. Pick the point on the map or use device location.

offers.title: Wait for providers, or contact them yourself
offers.body: Your request reaches providers of that profession working now in your area straight away, and they contact you. You can also contact whoever is available, or add the ones you like to "My directory" to contact them directly later without posting a request.

chat.title: Your description in every chat; "Forward" your messages
chat.body: Your request description, voice and photos appear at the top of every chat, so you never repeat them. After you send any message (voice, video or text), "Forward" appears beside it to send it to everyone on this request, or to one of them by name and number. When you agree with one, tap "Agreed" and the other chats close; or tap "Yes, stop the request" and tick "I found a service provider" to close and rate. The request stays in your archive.

finish.title: Confirm completion and leave a review
finish.body: Follow the status in the request details. You can mark work as started when it begins and confirm completion after the service is done. Reviews become available once the request is completed.

signup.title: Sign up with your phone in a minute
signup.body: Choose “{{role_provider}}” or “Both” and enter your phone and password. Your location is taken automatically; then choose your professions, covered districts, working days and hours and how you deliver the service. Your personal coupon appears after sign-up.

profile.title: The “My work” panel
profile.body: “My work” shows your professions, the districts you cover and your working hours. From there you add a new profession, pause when you are busy and resume, and edit your hours and vacation. You only see requests in your profession and area.

find.title: Requesters see you automatically
find.body: While you are available, your name appears to everyone requesting a service in your profession and district, and you are hidden during rest time and vacation. “Jobs for me” lists the open requests in your profession and area.

quote.title: Talk until you agree
quote.body: Open the request and tap “Contact the requester”, or wait for them to contact you. Agree in the chat on the work, price and time, with no price quotes. The requester taps “Agreed” when they choose you.

work.title: Do the work, then rate
work.body: After you agree, the request is assigned to you. Arrange the time and place, and confirm completion after the work. Each side rates the other once the request is completed.

help.venue_intro: At sign-up a provider picks one of three ways, and can change it any time from “Profile”. With the first and third, they pick their place on the map.

price.question: Is the displayed price final?
price.answer: Displayed service prices are estimates. The final price and time are set in the provider offer you accept. Confirm the work and price before it begins.

areas.question: Where is the service available now?
areas.answer: The service is available across Saudi Arabia. Select your region, governorate, city and neighborhood in a request or profile, or pick your location on the map. Finding a suitable provider depends on the offers you receive.

tracking.question: How do I follow my request?
tracking.answer: Customers can open “My Requests”, then a request’s details. Providers can follow their requests and offers in their account. Open the offer chat to negotiate and use it to coordinate work after acceptance. The tracking page shows a location when a participant shares it while the page is open.

dispute.question: What should I do if there is a disagreement?
dispute.answer: In the assigned request’s details, choose “Open a dispute”, select a reason, explain the issue and attach supporting information if you wish. Follow replies and updates on the dispute page.

subscription.question: Is sign-up free? When do I need a subscription?
subscription.answer: Sign-up is free, and requesters never pay. The monthly subscription is for providers only and applies in the areas and professions the administration sets; some professions stay free. If your profession needs a subscription in your area, a message appears in "My work" with a link to the subscription page.

language.question: How do I change the language and translate messages?
language.answer: Use the language button at the top of the page to choose Arabic, English, Urdu, Hindi or Bengali. User-written text and names stay as entered. In chat, choose “Translate on my device” for text or attachment audio, and select the recording language for audio. The feature needs your consent to download large models the first time, then processes the message on your device; some devices may not support it. The original stays available. Confirm the price and time with the other person.

contact.question: How do I contact the administration or send a suggestion?
contact.answer: From the ☰ menu choose "Contact the administration", pick the topic (technical support, suggestion or administration) and write your message. The reply comes on the same page with a notification, and a number on the menu shows new replies.

help.wallet_intro: Every provider gets a personal coupon at sign-up and earns a share when someone registers with it and pays. Find it under “Wallet & coupon” in the provider dashboard.

coupon.title: Your coupon
coupon.body: A permanent code of two letters and two digits such as KD27, longer when needed. It never changes and is never reused.

invite.title: Inviting
invite.body: Share your coupon or invitation link. The newcomer enters it at sign-up, or later in their wallet before their first payment.

commission.title: Commission
commission.body: When the newcomer's first online payment completes, a percentage set by the administrators is added to your balance automatically, once. Payments made from balances earn no commission.

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: Your balance and every movement appear in “Balance history”; the administrators see the same ledger.

withdraw.title: Withdrawing
withdraw.body: Request a withdrawal with the amount, IBAN and your password. The amount is held until the administrators transfer it and record the reference; it returns if rejected or you cancel.

gift.title: Paying for someone else
gift.body: Pay another provider's subscription from your balance using their coupon or phone. Their name is shown for confirmation; confirm with your password and it activates immediately.

security.title: Security
security.body: Every operation that lowers your balance needs your password, and the same money can never be spent twice. An SMS code will be added once an SMS provider is enabled.

payments.title: Payments are in test mode
payments.body: Until a real payment gateway is connected, a paid subscription opens a “test payment” page stating that no money will be charged. A test payment activates the subscription and calculates the coupon commission for trying things out only; bank withdrawals are disabled in this mode.

help.signup_intro: Signing up takes a minute, and everything you choose can be changed later from “Profile”.

types.title: Choose your account type
types.body: “Client” requests services, “Provider” offers them, and “Both” offers a service and needs others, like a driver who needs an electrician.

basics.title: Phone and password
basics.body: Your phone number and a 4-character password are enough; the name is optional. A 4-digit code arrives by SMS to confirm your number. If you forget your password, tap “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page to get a code and choose a new one.

location.title: Your location, automatically
location.body: Allow location access and your city and neighbourhood are detected automatically. Otherwise, pick your spot on the map. You are asked for the neighbourhood only if it cannot be detected.

professions.title: Professions (providers)
professions.body: Choose at least one profession; you can choose several, like plumber and electrician. Each profession's services are selected for you, and you untick what you do not offer. Clients do not choose professions.

coverage.title: Neighbourhoods you cover
coverage.body: Choose one or more neighbourhoods of your city that you serve, or tap “All”. Your own neighbourhood is preselected.

coupon.title: Customer number and invitation number
coupon.body: Every account has a permanent customer number of letters and digits (e.g. AB12), shown at the top of the site and in your account menu; you can sign in with it, your phone or your email. A provider's number is also their invitation number: if a provider invited you, type it in the “Invitation number” field while signing up. The “Create account” button stays off until the required fields are complete and valid, the terms are accepted and the verification code is entered.

matching.title: What your home page shows
matching.body: Providers see open requests in the neighbourhoods they cover and in their professions. Requesters see providers who cover their area in the profession they pick: featured (paid badge) first, then the highest rated. Change your area from “Edit your area” at the top. If you manage more than one home, tap “Another neighbourhood” to see the providers there without changing your registered one.

edit.title: Changing things later
edit.body: From “Profile” you can change your name, location, professions, neighbourhoods and service venue, and turn “Both” on or off. When requesting a service your saved location appears in one line, and opens only when you tap “Edit”.

change_type.title: Changing the account type
change_type.body: If you chose the wrong type at sign-up, open “Profile” → “Account type” and pick client, provider or both. Becoming a provider needs at least one profession, your districts and where you serve. You cannot leave providing while a job is in progress, nor become “provider only” with open requests (choose “Both”). Switching to client keeps your work details for later.

stats.title: Numbers that help you
stats.body: The services page lists every profession; each card shows how many providers serve your area, how many are available now or featured, their average rating and the open requests. Providers see “Your market in your area” on their dashboard: requesters registered in their neighbourhoods, open requests now, requesters in the last 30 days and competitors.

help.availability_intro: From “Profile” → “Availability and working hours” a provider controls when they are available; clients see the status in search and on the provider page.

pause.title: Pause and resume as you wish
pause.body: Tap “Pause” to stop until you tap “Resume”, with no end date.

vacation.title: Scheduled vacation
vacation.body: Set the start and end dates; you stop automatically on those days and come back afterwards.

days.title: Working days
days.body: Choose the weekdays you work; on other days you show as “Not a working day”.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.body: Set from and to hours; they may run past midnight. Leave empty to work all day. Times are Saudi time.

search.title: Shown in search
search.body: Clients see your status: available now, on vacation until a date, or outside working hours. Available providers come first, and clients can show “Available now” only.

help.appearance_body: Tap the “Appearance” circle at the top to choose light, dark or device mode, and a theme: Brand, Saudi (greens inspired by the Saudi emblem), Desert (sand colours), Mountain (inspired by the highlands), Sea (inspired by the sea and coast) or Burgundy. Pick one of four text sizes, and high contrast for low vision. Your choice is saved on your device.
help.calls_intro: Clients and providers call each other by voice or video from inside the chat, without sharing phone numbers.

ring.title: Ringing while the site is open
ring.body: The incoming call screen shows the caller's name with a ringtone, repeated vibration and Answer / Decline buttons.

closed.title: With the site or app closed
closed.body: Turn on “Call alerts” in your profile once per device. You then get a vibrating call notification that stays until you act; tapping it opens the chat to answer.

iphone.title: On iPhone
iphone.body: iPhone allows notifications after you add the site to the Home Screen from Safari (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from the icon.

network.title: Weak network
network.body: If either side loses the network for a few seconds the call stays up and resumes automatically; it ends only when hung up or after a long outage.

chat.title: Chat like WhatsApp
chat.body: Send text, photos, video, voice messages and your location. The microphone button records a voice message and turns into Send while you type. Tap a photo to view it full screen.

delete.title: Deleting messages and admin access
delete.body: Only the author can delete a message, after confirming; it then disappears for both people. Administrators keep every message, including deleted ones, and can review them to protect everyone's rights in a dispute.
